cli.about: Local speech-to-text: dictate into any field, transcribe any device, publish to other programs
cli.help.tui: Run the terminal UI instead of the desktop window
cli.help.web: Serve the settings page to a browser on 127.0.0.1
cli.help.daemon: Run without any UI; logs go to stderr
cli.help.install: Install anya for the current user and exit
cli.subscribe.about: Print a running Anya's frames as NDJSON
cli.replay.about: Serve a recorded frame stream to subscribers
cli.plugin.search.about: List the plugins in the registry
cli.plugin.install.about: Install a plugin, disabled (id or id@version)
cli.help.plugin_query: Show only plugins whose id, name or description contains this
cli.help.plugin_install_id: The plugin id, optionally id@version (the newest release otherwise)
cli.plugin.bun_download: Downloading the Bun runtime that runs plugins…
cli.plugin.note.engine: An engine plugin receives the audio of every session opened on its engine.
cli.plugin.note.context: A context plugin learns which app has focus when you dictate.
cli.plugin.note.text: A transform or action plugin receives everything you dictate.
cli.plugin.note.host: It runs in a Bun process of its own, with your rights.
cli.plugin.note.inline: It runs inline in Anya, with no network and no disk.
cli.plugin.enable_hint: If you accept that, turn it on with: anya plugin enable {id}
cli.plugin.enabled: Enabled {id}. Restart Anya to load it.
cli.plugin.needs_settings: It needs settings first: {fields}. Fill them in on the settings window's Plugins page, or under [plugins.settings.{id}] in the config file; its hooks do not run until then.
cli.plugin.disabled: Disabled {id}. Restart Anya to stop it.
cli.plugin.removed: Removed {id}. Restart Anya if it was running.
cli.plugin.builtin.about: List the built-in plugins, or turn one on or off
cli.plugin.builtin.chosen: {id} is chosen for {uses} and stays on; choose another engine for it first
cli.plugin.builtin.turned_on: Turned {id} on. A running Anya picks the change up from the config file.
cli.plugin.builtin.turned_off: Turned {id} off. A running Anya picks the change up from the config file.
cli.plugin.list.no_bun: Plugins are enabled but Bun 1.2 or newer was not found; install Bun, or install a plugin once to download it
cli.help.timeout: Exit after this long, e.g. 30s or 10m; 0 is unlimited
cli.help.max_events: Exit after this many frames; 0 is unlimited
cli.help.fast: Send frames as fast as possible instead of paced
cli.install.not_on_path: Note: {dir} is not in PATH; add it to your shell profile to run anya directly.
